name: Francis Walker
bio: A Representative from Virginia; born at ``Castle Hill,'' near Cobham, Albemarle County, Va., June 22, 1764; magistrate of Albemarle County; colonel of the Eighty-eighth Regiment, Virginia Militia; member of the state house of delegates 1788-1791 and 1797-1801; elected to the Third Congress (March 4, 1793-March 3, 1795); died at ``Castle Hill,'' near Cobham, Va., in March 1806; interment in the family cemetery at ``Castle Hill.''
